Name: Published Reference Anchor
Allowed Canon Ceiling: L4 if tests and publication boundary pass
Typical Sources: Zenodo DOI record, release artifact, citable PDF
Stop Rule: Cannot update interpretation beyond the published artifact without a new release or companion note

Name: Reviewed Repo Governance
Allowed Canon Ceiling: L4 if tests and SENS pass
Typical Sources: CAP IPERKA files, rulebooks, causal logs, reviewed CSVs
Stop Rule: Cannot override a higher-precedence published/reference anchor without explicit delta

Name: Live Notion System Record
Typical Sources: CAP page, registry database, system wiki, dashboard views
Stop Rule: Cannot create public canon or code truth by itself

Name: Extracted Mermaid or Atlas Graph
Typical Sources: MMD graph extraction, Mermaid relation map, visual trigger bridge
Use: Routing hypotheses, relation discovery, module candidates
Stop Rule: Cannot assign canonical TRG ID or execution behavior alone

Name: Trigger Ledger or Source Complement
Typical Sources: gap ledger, trigger map, reviewed trigger complement
Stop Rule: Cannot infer missing trigger semantics from neighboring numbers

Name: Raw Export or Snapshot
Typical Sources: Home-Ansichten export, private page snapshot, raw workspace dump
Use: Inventory support and review queue input
Stop Rule: Cannot enter public canon or reveal raw private IDs

Name: Session Directive
Typical Sources: Explicit GO, /fff, chat decision, recovery instruction
Use: Authorize work mode, mutation permission or prioritization

Name: Assistant Inference
Typical Sources: Codex synthesis, probabilistic pattern, generated summary
Use: Create queue item or review question
Stop Rule: Cannot be canon unless converted into source-backed evidence
